title: WSUG: Fix grammatical and formatting issues
description:
Used AI (Claude Sonnet) to check WSUG for
grammatical issues. Fixes include typos,
improper grammar, missing periods, extra spacing,
and broken Asciidoctor formatting.

AI-Assisted: yes

notes.body: This part I wasn't sure how to best describe; feedback especially welcome here.

It's trying to refer to the same thing discussed in more detail in `===== TKs and Performance` below. Perhaps it should just say something like "However, see TKs and Performance below (or link to it.)

How about changing it to this?

> ```null
> Note that if a TK is provided as a key, then the EAPOL 4-way handshake is not necessary,
> as the entire reason the 4-way handshake is needed is to derive the TK.
> ```

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/26160/diffs?diff_id=1962960642&start_sha=a6333c43661603acda201c12c3a3f8e853adfb38#023407be4d4fbc32f3db5815663eeb1b1a3a70ad_1556_1554)
I think this fix is clear enough. It is certainly better than what was prior. If it is not, please feel free to reopen.
